recordedOnly.note: Measured across 10 runs in two sessions on one machine, each from a fresh build (pnpm test:render-count, matching what CI runs): componentRenders varies run to run (background game:status churn — see render-count.spec.mjs's module doc comment — is not phase-locked to the measurement window), so these are not exact-match gated. The quiet range is wider than any single session observed: one session read 19596-20976 and another read 18768 repeatably, which is why a run landing outside a range is reported rather than failed. distinctComponents IS exact-match gated above; it stayed 60 across every run.
